cat > /workspace/.build-logs/verify_imports.sh <<'VEOF'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: verify_imports.sh
declare -A MODS=(
  [berichtskonfigurator]="berichtskonfigurator"
  [decision-log-store-service]="decision_log_store_service"
  [demos-einwendungsmanagement]="demos_einwendungsmanagement_services"
  [dokumentenaufbereitung-data-service]="dokumentenaufbereitung_data_service"
  [dokumentenaufbereitung-monorepo]="dokumentenaufbereitung_monorepo"
  [dokumentenpruefung]="dokumentenpruefung"
  [dokumentenschwaerzung-orchestrator]="dokumentenschwaerzung_orchestrator"
  [dokumentenschwaerzung-pdf-pii-detector]="pdf_pii_detector"
  [dokumentensuche]="src.main"
  [fristenmanagement]="fristenmanagement"
  [graph-api]="graph_api"
  [ki-guv-ai-testing]="ai_testing_api"
  [ki-guv-explainability]="explainability_transparency_api"
  [ki-guv-feedback]="feedback_api"
  [kommentar-service]="src.main"
  [nachforderungen]="src.main"
  [ner-extraction]="ner_extraction"
  [norm-matching]="normen_extraktion"
  [rechtsquellenvorbereitung]="rechtsquellenvorbereitung"
  [request-proxy]="request_proxy"
  [risikohinweis-service]="risk_assessment"
  [subsumtion-service]="subsumtion"
  [tex2pdf-service]="html2pdf_core"
  [xoev-adapter]="xoev_adapter"
  [demospipes-base-api]="demospipes_api"
  [demospipes-base-executors]="demospipes_core"
  [demospipes-bmds-api]="demospipes_addon_bmds_api"
  [demospipes-bmds-executors]="demospipes_addon_bmds_executors"
)
ok=0; fail=0
for img in "${!MODS[@]}"; do
  mod="${MODS[$img]}"
  out=$(docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "
    py=/app/.venv/bin/python; [ -x \$py ] || py=python3;
    cd /app 2>/dev/null || cd /;
    \$py -c 'import ${mod}' 2>&1 && echo IMPORT_OK
  " 2>&1 | tail -3)
  if echo "$out" | grep -q IMPORT_OK; then
    echo "OK   $img (import ${mod})"; ok=$((ok+1))
  else
    echo "FAIL $img (import ${mod})"; echo "$out" | head -3 | sed 's/^/     /'; fail=$((fail+1))
  fi
done
echo "===================="
echo "IMPORT OK=$ok FAIL=$fail"
VEOF
chmod +x /workspace/.build-logs/verify_imports.sh && /workspace/.build-logs/verify_imports.sh 2>&1 | tail -35
